Plate looks like a square dinner plate of about 24 cm, spanning roughly 465 px, so about 0.05 cm per px... that is about 19 px per cm.

The sweet potato cluster covers roughly 275-530 px wide by 235-435 px tall, so about 13 cm by 10 cm of bounding area. The pieces fill perhaps 50% of that. I count about 10 pieces, each roughly 3 cm by 2.5 cm by 2 cm, which is about 15 cm³ or 15 g. Ten pieces come to about 150 g. Some pieces are smaller, so I'll estimate about 120 g.

There is no visible oil or sauce beyond a slight sheen.
